# Billing Disputes Policy

Customers who identify incorrect charges on their account should raise a billing dispute 
within 60 days of the charge date. Disputes raised after this window may not be eligible 
for review. To raise a dispute, customers must provide their account ID, the charge date, 
and a description of the discrepancy.

Duplicate charges are automatically refunded within 3-5 business days once verified. 
For disputed subscription renewals, the account will be temporarily suspended from 
further billing while the dispute is under review. Resolution typically takes 7-10 
business days.

# Escalation Criteria

Tickets are escalated to a human senior agent (bypassing automated resolution) when any 
of the following conditions are met:

- Priority is Critical or the ticket body explicitly mentions a data breach, outage 
  affecting multiple users, or legal/compliance concern.
- The customer has submitted 3 or more unresolved tickets on the same issue within 7 days.
- The automated response system expresses low confidence (below 40%) in the generated answer.
- The customer explicitly requests human assistance.

Escalated tickets are flagged in the system and assigned to an available senior agent 
within the SLA window for their priority level. Automated responses are not sent for 
escalated tickets.

# General Support Process

When a support ticket is submitted, it is automatically classified by category and 
priority. Routine tickets receive an AI-assisted draft response within the SLA window, 
grounded in resolved similar tickets or relevant policy documents. Customers are notified 
by email when their ticket receives a response.

If the automated response does not resolve the issue, customers can reply to the ticket 
to continue the conversation or request escalation to a human agent. Tickets are 
automatically closed after 7 days of inactivity. Customers can reopen a closed ticket 
within 30 days by replying to the closure notification.

# Refunds and Returns Policy

Customers are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided the product 
or service has not been fully consumed or activated. Refund requests must be submitted 
through the support portal with a valid order ID and reason for return. Processing takes 
5-7 business days after approval.

For digital products and software licenses, refunds are only issued if the product is 
reported non-functional within 7 days of purchase and the issue cannot be resolved by 
the support team. Partially used subscriptions are refunded on a pro-rata basis.

# Security Incident Handling Policy

Any ticket reporting a suspected data breach, unauthorized access, or encryption failure 
must be immediately escalated to the Security Response Team regardless of the original 
queue assignment. These tickets are automatically assigned Critical priority and bypass 
the standard SLA queue.

Customers reporting security incidents should avoid sharing sensitive credentials or 
personal data in the ticket body. The Security Response Team will initiate a secure 
communication channel within 1 hour of ticket receipt. All security incidents are logged, 
investigated, and reported in compliance with applicable data protection regulations.

# Service Level Agreement: Response Times

Response time targets are based on ticket priority level assigned at the time of submission:

- Critical: First response within 1 hour. Assigned to a senior support engineer immediately.
  Reserved for full service outages, data breaches, or complete loss of business function.
- High: First response within 4 hours. Assigned to a specialist within the relevant queue.
  Reserved for significant disruption affecting multiple users or core business processes.
- Medium: First response within 1 business day. Standard support queue assignment.
  Reserved for partial disruptions, workarounds available, single-user issues.
- Low: First response within 3 business days. General queue assignment.
  Reserved for informational requests, minor inconveniences, and feature inquiries.

SLA timers pause outside business hours (9am-6pm local time, Monday to Friday).
